footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 15.3% to $13.6M in 2025. Gross margin was 52.9%, versus 54.2% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $25.5M from $19.9M.
The net loss widened to $25.3M, or −$1.03 per share, from $19.9M. Operating cash flow was −$22.9M and free cash flow −$23.0M, versus −$20.2M.
sources: CapsoVision, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: Our audited financial statements for the years ended December 31, 2025 and December 31…
All of our revenues to date have been, and in the near-term will continue to be, generated from CapsoCam Plus related sales for the small bowel…
Broad adoption of our CapsoCam Colon solution (once cleared) and growing related revenues depend on, among other things…
Our longer term efforts to expand our GI-tract capsule endoscopy solutions beyond small bowel and colon pathologies…
Any failure or defect in our GI-tract capsule endoscopy solution could harm our reputation, expose us to liability, and reduce our sales
strategy: Expand clinical use cases and accessories for CapsoCam Plus
Continue to improve and innovate our GI-tract capsule endoscopy solution
